function.name: find_nearby_stations
function.description: This endpoint provides a list of nearby weather stations for a given geographical location.

lat_long.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude.

returns.description: A list of dictionaries about the various stations near the specified location.

function.name: get_current_location
function.description: Returns the current location. ONLY use this if the user has not provided an explicit location in the query.

returns.description: The current location as a string (e.g., 'Austin').

function.name: get_current_time_at_location
function.description: Returns the current time at a given location.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the location.

returns.description: The current time at the specified location.

function.name: get_hourly_observation
function.description: Returns hourly observations between start_time and end_time.

station_id.description: The station_id for the station of interest.

time_zone.description: The timezone string ID for the location.

returns.description: A list of hourly observations for the specified station and timespan.

function.name: get_latitude_longitude
function.description: Given a city name, this function provides the latitude and longitude of the specific location.

location.description: The name of the location (e.g., 'Austin', 'Austin Airport').

returns.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude of the location.

function.name: get_nearest_station_id
function.description: Given a list of nearby stations, returns the one nearest to you and provides the system ID for it alone.

nearby_stations.description: A list of nearby stations in dictionary format.

returns.description: The station_id for the nearest station in the list.

function.name: get_timezone
function.description: This function retrieves the timezone for a given latitude and longitude.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the area.

returns.description: The timezone string ID for the specified location.

function.name: subtract_time_delta
function.description: Subtracts a time delta from the date part of a given date time string and returns the new date string.

date_time_str.description: The date time string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

delta_days.description: Number of days to subtract. Must be greater than 0.

returns.description: The new date string after subtracting the delta.

function.name: find_nearby_stations
function.description: This endpoint provides a list of nearby weather stations for a given geographical location.

lat_long.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude.

returns.description: A list of dictionaries about the various stations near the specified location.

function.name: get_current_location
function.description: Returns the current location. ONLY use this if the user has not provided an explicit location in the query.

returns.description: The current location as a string (e.g., 'Austin').

function.name: get_current_time_at_location
function.description: Returns the current time at a given location.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the location.

returns.description: The current time at the specified location.

function.name: get_hourly_observation
function.description: Returns hourly observations between start_time and end_time.

station_id.description: The station_id for the station of interest.

time_zone.description: The timezone string ID for the location.

returns.description: A list of hourly observations for the specified station and timespan.

function.name: get_latitude_longitude
function.description: Given a city name, this function provides the latitude and longitude of the specific location.

location.description: The name of the location (e.g., 'Austin', 'Austin Airport').

returns.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude of the location.

function.name: get_nearest_station_id
function.description: Given a list of nearby stations, returns the one nearest to you and provides the system ID for it alone.

nearby_stations.description: A list of nearby stations in dictionary format.

returns.description: The station_id for the nearest station in the list.

function.name: get_timezone
function.description: This function retrieves the timezone for a given latitude and longitude.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the area.

returns.description: The timezone string ID for the specified location.

function.name: subtract_time_delta
function.description: Subtracts a time delta from the date part of a given date time string and returns the new date string.

date_time_str.description: The date time string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

delta_days.description: Number of days to subtract. Must be greater than 0.

returns.description: The new date string after subtracting the delta.

lat_long.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude.

returns.description: A list of dictionaries about the various stations near the specified location.

function.name: get_current_location
function.description: Returns the current location. ONLY use this if the user has not provided an explicit location in the query.

returns.description: The current location as a string (e.g., 'Austin').

function.name: get_current_time_at_location
function.description: Returns the current time at a given location.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the location.

returns.description: The current time at the specified location.

function.name: get_hourly_observation
function.description: Returns hourly observations between start_time and end_time.

station_id.description: The station_id for the station of interest.

time_zone.description: The timezone string ID for the location.

returns.description: A list of hourly observations for the specified station and timespan.

function.name: get_latitude_longitude
function.description: Given a city name, this function provides the latitude and longitude of the specific location.

location.description: The name of the location (e.g., 'Austin', 'Austin Airport').

returns.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude of the location.

function.name: get_nearest_station_id
function.description: Given a list of nearby stations, returns the one nearest to you and provides the system ID for it alone.

nearby_stations.description: A list of nearby stations in dictionary format.

function.name: get_timezone
function.description: This function retrieves the timezone for a given latitude and longitude.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the area.

returns.description: The timezone string ID for the specified location.

date_time_str.description: The date time string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

delta_days.description: Number of days to subtract. Must be greater than 0.

returns.description: The new date string after subtracting the delta.

function.name: find_nearby_stations
function.description: This endpoint provides a list of nearby weather stations for a given geographical location.

lat_long.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude.

returns.description: A list of dictionaries about the various stations near the specified location.

function.name: get_current_location
function.description: Returns the current location. ONLY use this if the user has not provided an explicit location in the query.

returns.description: The current location as a string (e.g., 'Austin').

function.name: get_current_time_at_location
function.description: Returns the current time at a given location.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the location.

returns.description: The current time at the specified location.

function.name: get_hourly_observation
function.description: Returns hourly observations between start_time and end_time.

station_id.description: The station_id for the station of interest.

time_zone.description: The timezone string ID for the location.

returns.description: A list of hourly observations for the specified station and timespan.

function.name: get_latitude_longitude
function.description: Given a city name, this function provides the latitude and longitude of the specific location.

location.description: The name of the location (e.g., 'Austin', 'Austin Airport').

returns.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude of the location.

function.name: get_nearest_station_id
function.description: Given a list of nearby stations, returns the one nearest to you and provides the system ID for it alone.

nearby_stations.description: A list of nearby stations in dictionary format.

returns.description: The station_id for the nearest station in the list.

function.name: get_timezone
function.description: This function retrieves the timezone for a given latitude and longitude.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the area.

returns.description: The timezone string ID for the specified location.

function.name: subtract_time_delta
function.description: Subtracts a time delta from the date part of a given date time string and returns the new date string.

date_time_str.description: The date time string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

delta_days.description: Number of days to subtract. Must be greater than 0.

returns.description: The new date string after subtracting the delta.

function.description: This endpoint provides a list of nearby weather stations for a given geographical location.

function.name: get_current_location
function.description: Returns the current location. ONLY use this if the user has not provided an explicit location in the query.

returns.description: The current location as a string (e.g., 'Austin').

function.name: get_current_time_at_location
function.description: Returns the current time at a given location.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the location.

returns.description: The current time at the specified location.

function.name: get_hourly_observation
function.description: Returns hourly observations between start_time and end_time.

station_id.description: The station_id for the station of interest.

time_zone.description: The timezone string ID for the location.

returns.description: A list of hourly observations for the specified station and timespan.

function.name: get_latitude_longitude
function.description: Given a city name, this function provides the latitude and longitude of the specific location.

location.description: The name of the location (e.g., 'Austin', 'Austin Airport').

returns.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude of the location.

function.name: get_nearest_station_id
function.description: Given a list of nearby stations, returns the one nearest to you and provides the system ID for it alone.

nearby_stations.description: A list of nearby stations in dictionary format.

returns.description: The station_id for the nearest station in the list.

function.name: get_timezone
function.description: This function retrieves the timezone for a given latitude and longitude.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the area.

returns.description: The timezone string ID for the specified location.

function.name: subtract_time_delta
function.description: Subtracts a time delta from the date part of a given date time string and returns the new date string.

date_time_str.description: The date time string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

delta_days.description: Number of days to subtract. Must be greater than 0.

returns.description: The new date string after subtracting the delta.

function.name: find_nearby_stations
function.description: This endpoint provides a list of nearby weather stations for a given geographical location.

lat_long.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude.

returns.description: A list of dictionaries about the various stations near the specified location.

function.name: get_current_location
function.description: Returns the current location. ONLY use this if the user has not provided an explicit location in the query.

returns.description: The current location as a string (e.g., 'Austin').

function.name: get_current_time_at_location
function.description: Returns the current time at a given location.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the location.

returns.description: The current time at the specified location.

function.name: get_hourly_observation
function.description: Returns hourly observations between start_time and end_time.

station_id.description: The station_id for the station of interest.

time_zone.description: The timezone string ID for the location.

returns.description: A list of hourly observations for the specified station and timespan.

function.name: get_latitude_longitude
function.description: Given a city name, this function provides the latitude and longitude of the specific location.

location.description: The name of the location (e.g., 'Austin', 'Austin Airport').

returns.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude of the location.

function.name: get_nearest_station_id
function.description: Given a list of nearby stations, returns the one nearest to you and provides the system ID for it alone.

nearby_stations.description: A list of nearby stations in dictionary format.

returns.description: The station_id for the nearest station in the list.

function.name: get_timezone
function.description: This function retrieves the timezone for a given latitude and longitude.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the area.

returns.description: The timezone string ID for the specified location.

function.name: subtract_time_delta
function.description: Subtracts a time delta from the date part of a given date time string and returns the new date string.

date_time_str.description: The date time string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

delta_days.description: Number of days to subtract. Must be greater than 0.

returns.description: The new date string after subtracting the delta.

function.name: find_nearby_stations
function.description: This endpoint provides a list of nearby weather stations for a given geographical location.

lat_long.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude.

returns.description: A list of dictionaries about the various stations near the specified location.

function.name: get_current_location
function.description: Returns the current location. ONLY use this if the user has not provided an explicit location in the query.

returns.description: The current location as a string (e.g., 'Austin').

function.name: get_current_time_at_location
function.description: Returns the current time at a given location.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the location.

returns.description: The current time at the specified location.

function.name: get_hourly_observation
function.description: Returns hourly observations between start_time and end_time.

station_id.description: The station_id for the station of interest.

time_zone.description: The timezone string ID for the location.

returns.description: A list of hourly observations for the specified station and timespan.

function.name: get_latitude_longitude
function.description: Given a city name, this function provides the latitude and longitude of the specific location.

location.description: The name of the location (e.g., 'Austin', 'Austin Airport').

returns.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude of the location.

function.name: get_nearest_station_id
function.description: Given a list of nearby stations, returns the one nearest to you and provides the system ID for it alone.

nearby_stations.description: A list of nearby stations in dictionary format.

returns.description: The station_id for the nearest station in the list.

function.name: get_timezone
function.description: This function retrieves the timezone for a given latitude and longitude.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the area.

returns.description: The timezone string ID for the specified location.

function.name: subtract_time_delta
function.description: Subtracts a time delta from the date part of a given date time string and returns the new date string.

date_time_str.description: The date time string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

delta_days.description: Number of days to subtract. Must be greater than 0.

returns.description: The new date string after subtracting the delta.

lat_long.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude.

function.name: find_nearby_stations
function.description: This endpoint provides a list of nearby weather stations for a given geographical location.

lat_long.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude.

returns.description: A list of dictionaries about the various stations near the specified location.

function.name: get_current_location
function.description: Returns the current location. ONLY use this if the user has not provided an explicit location in the query.

returns.description: The current location as a string (e.g., 'Austin').

function.name: get_current_time_at_location
function.description: Returns the current time at a given location.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the location.

returns.description: The current time at the specified location.

function.name: get_hourly_observation
function.description: Returns hourly observations between start_time and end_time.

station_id.description: The station_id for the station of interest.

time_zone.description: The timezone string ID for the location.

returns.description: A list of hourly observations for the specified station and timespan.

function.name: get_latitude_longitude
function.description: Given a city name, this function provides the latitude and longitude of the specific location.

location.description: The name of the location (e.g., 'Austin', 'Austin Airport').

returns.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude of the location.

function.name: get_nearest_station_id
function.description: Given a list of nearby stations, returns the one nearest to you and provides the system ID for it alone.

nearby_stations.description: A list of nearby stations in dictionary format.

returns.description: The station_id for the nearest station in the list.

function.name: get_timezone
function.description: This function retrieves the timezone for a given latitude and longitude.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the area.

returns.description: The timezone string ID for the specified location.

function.name: subtract_time_delta
function.description: Subtracts a time delta from the date part of a given date time string and returns the new date string.

date_time_str.description: The date time string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

delta_days.description: Number of days to subtract. Must be greater than 0.

returns.description: The new date string after subtracting the delta.

function.name: find_nearby_stations
function.description: This endpoint provides a list of nearby weather stations for a given geographical location.

lat_long.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude.

returns.description: A list of dictionaries about the various stations near the specified location.

function.name: get_current_location
function.description: Returns the current location. ONLY use this if the user has not provided an explicit location in the query.

returns.description: The current location as a string (e.g., 'Austin').

function.name: get_current_time_at_location
function.description: Returns the current time at a given location.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the location.

returns.description: The current time at the specified location.

function.name: get_hourly_observation
function.description: Returns hourly observations between start_time and end_time.

station_id.description: The station_id for the station of interest.

time_zone.description: The timezone string ID for the location.

returns.description: A list of hourly observations for the specified station and timespan.

function.name: get_latitude_longitude
function.description: Given a city name, this function provides the latitude and longitude of the specific location.

location.description: The name of the location (e.g., 'Austin', 'Austin Airport').

returns.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude of the location.

function.name: get_nearest_station_id
function.description: Given a list of nearby stations, returns the one nearest to you and provides the system ID for it alone.

nearby_stations.description: A list of nearby stations in dictionary format.

returns.description: The station_id for the nearest station in the list.

function.name: get_timezone
function.description: This function retrieves the timezone for a given latitude and longitude.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the area.

returns.description: The timezone string ID for the specified location.

function.name: subtract_time_delta
function.description: Subtracts a time delta from the date part of a given date time string and returns the new date string.

date_time_str.description: The date time string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

delta_days.description: Number of days to subtract. Must be greater than 0.

returns.description: The new date string after subtracting the delta.

function.description: This endpoint provides a list of nearby weather stations for a given geographical location.

lat_long.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude.

returns.description: A list of dictionaries about the various stations near the specified location.

function.name: get_current_location
function.description: Returns the current location. ONLY use this if the user has not provided an explicit location in the query.

returns.description: The current location as a string (e.g., 'Austin').

function.name: get_current_time_at_location
function.description: Returns the current time at a given location.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the location.

returns.description: The current time at the specified location.

function.description: Returns hourly observations between start_time and end_time.

station_id.description: The station_id for the station of interest.

time_zone.description: The timezone string ID for the location.

returns.description: A list of hourly observations for the specified station and timespan.

function.description: Given a city name, this function provides the latitude and longitude of the specific location.

location.description: The name of the location (e.g., 'Austin', 'Austin Airport').

returns.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude of the location.

function.name: get_nearest_station_id
function.description: Given a list of nearby stations, returns the one nearest to you and provides the system ID for it alone.

nearby_stations.description: A list of nearby stations in dictionary format.

returns.description: The station_id for the nearest station in the list.

function.name: get_timezone
function.description: This function retrieves the timezone for a given latitude and longitude.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the area.

returns.description: The timezone string ID for the specified location.

function.description: Subtracts a time delta from the date part of a given date time string and returns the new date string.

date_time_str.description: The date time string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

delta_days.description: Number of days to subtract. Must be greater than 0.

returns.description: The new date string after subtracting the delta.

function.name: find_nearby_stations
function.description: This endpoint provides a list of nearby weather stations for a given geographical location.

lat_long.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude.

returns.description: A list of dictionaries about the various stations near the specified location.

function.name: get_current_location
function.description: Returns the current location. ONLY use this if the user has not provided an explicit location in the query.

returns.description: The current location as a string (e.g., 'Austin').

function.name: get_current_time_at_location
function.description: Returns the current time at a given location.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the location.

returns.description: The current time at the specified location.

function.name: get_hourly_observation
function.description: Returns hourly observations between start_time and end_time.

station_id.description: The station_id for the station of interest.

time_zone.description: The timezone string ID for the location.

returns.description: A list of hourly observations for the specified station and timespan.

function.name: get_latitude_longitude
function.description: Given a city name, this function provides the latitude and longitude of the specific location.

location.description: The name of the location (e.g., 'Austin', 'Austin Airport').

returns.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude of the location.

function.name: get_nearest_station_id
function.description: Given a list of nearby stations, returns the one nearest to you and provides the system ID for it alone.

nearby_stations.description: A list of nearby stations in dictionary format.

returns.description: The station_id for the nearest station in the list.

function.name: get_timezone
function.description: This function retrieves the timezone for a given latitude and longitude.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the area.

returns.description: The timezone string ID for the specified location.

function.name: subtract_time_delta
function.description: Subtracts a time delta from the date part of a given date time string and returns the new date string.

date_time_str.description: The date time string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

delta_days.description: Number of days to subtract. Must be greater than 0.

returns.description: The new date string after subtracting the delta.

function.name: find_nearby_stations
function.description: This endpoint provides a list of nearby weather stations for a given geographical location.

lat_long.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude.

returns.description: A list of dictionaries about the various stations near the specified location.

function.name: get_current_location
function.description: Returns the current location. ONLY use this if the user has not provided an explicit location in the query.

returns.description: The current location as a string (e.g., 'Austin').

function.name: get_current_time_at_location
function.description: Returns the current time at a given location.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the location.

returns.description: The current time at the specified location.

function.name: get_hourly_observation
function.description: Returns hourly observations between start_time and end_time.

station_id.description: The station_id for the station of interest.

time_zone.description: The timezone string ID for the location.

returns.description: A list of hourly observations for the specified station and timespan.

function.name: get_latitude_longitude
function.description: Given a city name, this function provides the latitude and longitude of the specific location.

location.description: The name of the location (e.g., 'Austin', 'Austin Airport').

returns.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude of the location.

function.name: get_nearest_station_id
function.description: Given a list of nearby stations, returns the one nearest to you and provides the system ID for it alone.

nearby_stations.description: A list of nearby stations in dictionary format.

returns.description: The station_id for the nearest station in the list.

function.name: get_timezone
function.description: This function retrieves the timezone for a given latitude and longitude.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the area.

returns.description: The timezone string ID for the specified location.

function.name: subtract_time_delta
function.description: Subtracts a time delta from the date part of a given date time string and returns the new date string.

date_time_str.description: The date time string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

delta_days.description: Number of days to subtract. Must be greater than 0.

returns.description: The new date string after subtracting the delta.

returns.description: The current location as a string (e.g., 'Austin').

function.description: Returns the current time at a given location.

function.description: Returns hourly observations between start_time and end_time.

function.description: Given a list of nearby stations, returns the one nearest to you and provides the system ID for it alone.

function.description: This function retrieves the timezone for a given latitude and longitude.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the area.

date_time_str.description: The date time string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

delta_days.description: Number of days to subtract. Must be greater than 0.

returns.description: The new date string after subtracting the delta.

import json
import requests
from datetime import datetime, timedelta

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1️⃣  Get the device’s current location (city name)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
def get_current_location():
    """Returns a string like 'London'."""
    resp = requests.post(
        "https://api.example.com/get_current_location",   # ← replace with real URL
        json={}
    )
    resp.raise_for_status()
    return resp.json()          # e.g. "London"


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2️⃣  Convert a city name → latitude / longitude
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
def get_lat_long(city_name):
    resp = requests.post(
        "https://api.example.com/get_latitude_longitude",
        json={"location": city_name}
    )
    resp.raise_for_status()
    data = resp.json()          # {"latitude": 51.5072, "longitude": 0.1276}
    return data["latitude"], data["longitude"]


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3️⃣  Find stations near those coordinates
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
def find_nearby_stations(lat, lon):
    resp = requests.post(
        "https://api.example.com/find_nearby_stations",
        json={"lat_long": [lat, lon]}
    )
    resp.raise_for_status()
    return resp.json()          # list of dicts (station_id, name, distance, …)


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4️⃣  Pick the nearest station (returns just the system‑wide ID)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
def get_nearest_station_id(stations):
    resp = requests.post(
        "https://api.example.com/get_nearest_station_id",
        json={"nearby_stations": stations}
    )
    resp.raise_for_status()
    return resp.json()["station_id"]   # e.g. "EGLL"


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5️⃣  Get the IANA timezone for the lat/long (needed for timestamps)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
def get_timezone(lat, lon):
    resp = requests.post(
        "https://api.example.com/get_timezone",
        json={"lat_long": [lat, lon]}
    )
    resp.raise_for_status()
    return resp.json()["timezone"]      # e.g. "Europe/London"


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6️⃣  (Optional) Pull hourly observations for a station
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
def get_hourly_observation(station_id, start_date, end_date, tz):
    """
    start_date / end_date → strings in 'YYYY‑MM‑DD' format.
    Returns a list of hourly dicts (datetime, temperature_c, …).
    """
    resp = requests.post(
        "https://api.example.com/get_hourly_observation",
        json={
            "station_id": station_id,
            "start_time": start_date,
            "end_time":   end_date,
            "time_zone":  tz
        }
    )
    resp.raise_for_status()
    return resp.json()


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# 7️⃣  Main workflow
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
def main():
    # ---- Step 1: locate the user ------------------------------------
    city = get_current_location()
    print(f"📍 Detected location: {city}")

    # ---- Step 2: lat / long -----------------------------------------
    lat, lon = get_lat_long(city)
    print(f"🔎 Latitude / Longitude: {lat:.4f}, {lon:.4f}")

    # ---- Step 3: nearby stations ------------------------------------
    stations = find_nearby_stations(lat, lon)
    print(f"🔎 Found {len(stations)} stations nearby.")

    # ---- Step 4: nearest station ------------------------------------
    nearest_id = get_nearest_station_id(stations)
    nearest_name = next(s["name"] for s in stations if s["station_id"] == nearest_id)
    print(f"✅ Nearest station: {nearest_name} (ID: {nearest_id})")

    # ---- Step 5: timezone -------------------------------------------
    tz = get_timezone(lat, lon)
    print(f"🕒 Timezone for the location: {tz}")

    # ---- Step 6 (optional): fetch recent hourly data ---------------
    # Example: last 2 full days
    today = datetime.utcnow().date()
    start = (today - timedelta(days=2)).isoformat()   # e.g. "2025-10-18"
    end   = today.isoformat()                         # e.g. "2025-10-20"

    observations = get_hourly_observation(
        station_id=nearest_id,
        start_date=start,
        end_date=end,
        tz=tz
    )
    print(f"📊 Received {len(observations)} hourly records.")
    for rec in observations[:5]:          # show a few rows
        print(json.dumps(rec, indent=2))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

function.name: find_nearby_stations
function.description: This endpoint provides a list of nearby weather stations for a given geographical location.

lat_long.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude.

returns.description: A list of dictionaries about the various stations near the specified location.

function.name: get_current_location
function.description: Returns the current location. ONLY use this if the user has not provided an explicit location in the query.

returns.description: The current location as a string (e.g., 'Austin').

function.name: get_current_time_at_location
function.description: Returns the current time at a given location.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the location.

returns.description: The current time at the specified location.

function.name: get_hourly_observation
function.description: Returns hourly observations between start_time and end_time.

station_id.description: The station_id for the station of interest.

time_zone.description: The timezone string ID for the location.

returns.description: A list of hourly observations for the specified station and timespan.

function.name: get_latitude_longitude
function.description: Given a city name, this function provides the latitude and longitude of the specific location.

location.description: The name of the location (e.g., 'Austin', 'Austin Airport').

returns.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude of the location.

function.name: get_nearest_station_id
function.description: Given a list of nearby stations, returns the one nearest to you and provides the system ID for it alone.

nearby_stations.description: A list of nearby stations in dictionary format.

returns.description: The station_id for the nearest station in the list.

function.name: get_timezone
function.description: This function retrieves the timezone for a given latitude and longitude.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the area.

returns.description: The timezone string ID for the specified location.

function.name: subtract_time_delta
function.description: Subtracts a time delta from the date part of a given date time string and returns the new date string.

date_time_str.description: The date time string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

delta_days.description: Number of days to subtract. Must be greater than 0.

returns.description: The new date string after subtracting the delta.

function.description: This endpoint provides a list of nearby weather stations for a given geographical location.

lat_long.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude.

returns.description: A list of dictionaries about the various stations near the specified location.

function.name: get_current_location
function.description: Returns the current location. ONLY use this if the user has not provided an explicit location in the query.

returns.description: The current location as a string (e.g., 'Austin').

function.name: get_current_time_at_location
function.description: Returns the current time at a given location.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the location.

returns.description: The current time at the specified location.

function.name: get_hourly_observation
function.description: Returns hourly observations between start_time and end_time.

station_id.description: The station_id for the station of interest.

time_zone.description: The timezone string ID for the location.

returns.description: A list of hourly observations for the specified station and timespan.

function.name: get_latitude_longitude
function.description: Given a city name, this function provides the latitude and longitude of the specific location.

location.description: The name of the location (e.g., 'Austin', 'Austin Airport').

returns.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude of the location.

function.name: get_nearest_station_id
function.description: Given a list of nearby stations, returns the one nearest to you and provides the system ID for it alone.

nearby_stations.description: A list of nearby stations in dictionary format.

returns.description: The station_id for the nearest station in the list.

function.name: get_timezone
function.description: This function retrieves the timezone for a given latitude and longitude.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the area.

returns.description: The timezone string ID for the specified location.

function.name: subtract_time_delta
function.description: Subtracts a time delta from the date part of a given date time string and returns the new date string.

date_time_str.description: The date time string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

delta_days.description: Number of days to subtract. Must be greater than 0.

returns.description: The new date string after subtracting the delta.

function.name: find_nearby_stations
function.description: This endpoint provides a list of nearby weather stations for a given geographical location.

lat_long.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude.

returns.description: A list of dictionaries about the various stations near the specified location.

function.name: get_current_location
function.description: Returns the current location. ONLY use this if the user has not provided an explicit location in the query.

returns.description: The current location as a string (e.g., 'Austin').

function.name: get_current_time_at_location
function.description: Returns the current time at a given location.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the location.

returns.description: The current time at the specified location.

function.name: get_hourly_observation
function.description: Returns hourly observations between start_time and end_time.

station_id.description: The station_id for the station of interest.

time_zone.description: The timezone string ID for the location.

returns.description: A list of hourly observations for the specified station and timespan.

function.name: get_latitude_longitude
function.description: Given a city name, this function provides the latitude and longitude of the specific location.

location.description: The name of the location (e.g., 'Austin', 'Austin Airport').

returns.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude of the location.

function.name: get_nearest_station_id
function.description: Given a list of nearby stations, returns the one nearest to you and provides the system ID for it alone.

nearby_stations.description: A list of nearby stations in dictionary format.

returns.description: The station_id for the nearest station in the list.

function.name: get_timezone
function.description: This function retrieves the timezone for a given latitude and longitude.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the area.

returns.description: The timezone string ID for the specified location.

function.name: subtract_time_delta
function.description: Subtracts a time delta from the date part of a given date time string and returns the new date string.

date_time_str.description: The date time string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

delta_days.description: Number of days to subtract. Must be greater than 0.

returns.description: The new date string after subtracting the delta.

function.description: Returns the current location. ONLY use this if the user has not provided an explicit location in the query.

returns.description: The current location as a string (e.g., 'Austin').

function.description: Returns the current time at a given location.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the location.

time_zone.description: The timezone string ID for the location.

returns.description: A list of hourly observations for the specified station and timespan.

function.description: Given a city name, this function provides the latitude and longitude of the specific location.

location.description: The name of the location (e.g., 'Austin', 'Austin Airport').

returns.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude of the location.

function.name: get_nearest_station_id
function.description: Given a list of nearby stations, returns the one nearest to you and provides the system ID for it alone.

nearby_stations.description: A list of nearby stations in dictionary format.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the area.

returns.description: The timezone string ID for the specified location.

function.name: subtract_time_delta

date_time_str.description: The date time string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

delta_days.description: Number of days to subtract. Must be greater than 0.

returns.description: The new date string after subtracting the delta.

function.name: find_nearby_stations
function.description: This endpoint provides a list of nearby weather stations for a given geographical location.

lat_long.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude.

returns.description: A list of dictionaries about the various stations near the specified location.

function.name: get_current_location
function.description: Returns the current location. ONLY use this if the user has not provided an explicit location in the query.

returns.description: The current location as a string (e.g., 'Austin').

function.name: get_current_time_at_location
function.description: Returns the current time at a given location.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the location.

returns.description: The current time at the specified location.

function.name: get_hourly_observation
function.description: Returns hourly observations between start_time and end_time.

station_id.description: The station_id for the station of interest.

time_zone.description: The timezone string ID for the location.

returns.description: A list of hourly observations for the specified station and timespan.

function.name: get_latitude_longitude
function.description: Given a city name, this function provides the latitude and longitude of the specific location.

location.description: The name of the location (e.g., 'Austin', 'Austin Airport').

returns.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude of the location.

function.name: get_nearest_station_id
function.description: Given a list of nearby stations, returns the one nearest to you and provides the system ID for it alone.

nearby_stations.description: A list of nearby stations in dictionary format.

returns.description: The station_id for the nearest station in the list.

function.name: get_timezone
function.description: This function retrieves the timezone for a given latitude and longitude.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the area.

returns.description: The timezone string ID for the specified location.

function.name: subtract_time_delta
function.description: Subtracts a time delta from the date part of a given date time string and returns the new date string.

date_time_str.description: The date time string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

delta_days.description: Number of days to subtract. Must be greater than 0.

returns.description: The new date string after subtracting the delta.

function.name: find_nearby_stations
function.description: This endpoint provides a list of nearby weather stations for a given geographical location.

lat_long.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude.

returns.description: A list of dictionaries about the various stations near the specified location.

function.name: get_current_location
function.description: Returns the current location. ONLY use this if the user has not provided an explicit location in the query.

returns.description: The current location as a string (e.g., 'Austin').

function.name: get_current_time_at_location
function.description: Returns the current time at a given location.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the location.

returns.description: The current time at the specified location.

function.name: get_hourly_observation
function.description: Returns hourly observations between start_time and end_time.

station_id.description: The station_id for the station of interest.

time_zone.description: The timezone string ID for the location.

returns.description: A list of hourly observations for the specified station and timespan.

function.name: get_latitude_longitude
function.description: Given a city name, this function provides the latitude and longitude of the specific location.

location.description: The name of the location (e.g., 'Austin', 'Austin Airport').

returns.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude of the location.

function.name: get_nearest_station_id

function.description: This endpoint provides a list of nearby weather stations for a given geographical location.

lat_long.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude.

returns.description: A list of dictionaries about the various stations near the specified location.

function.name: get_current_location
function.description: Returns the current location. ONLY use this if the user has not provided an explicit location in the query.

returns.description: The current location as a string (e.g., 'Austin').

function.name: get_current_time_at_location
function.description: Returns the current time at a given location.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the location.

returns.description: The current time at the specified location.

function.name: get_hourly_observation
function.description: Returns hourly observations between start_time and end_time.

station_id.description: The station_id for the station of interest.

time_zone.description: The timezone string ID for the location.

returns.description: A list of hourly observations for the specified station and timespan.

function.name: get_latitude_longitude
function.description: Given a city name, this function provides the latitude and longitude of the specific location.

location.description: The name of the location (e.g., 'Austin', 'Austin Airport').

returns.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude of the location.

function.name: get_nearest_station_id
function.description: Given a list of nearby stations, returns the one nearest to you and provides the system ID for it alone.

nearby_stations.description: A list of nearby stations in dictionary format.

returns.description: The station_id for the nearest station in the list.

function.name: get_timezone
function.description: This function retrieves the timezone for a given latitude and longitude.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the area.

returns.description: The timezone string ID for the specified location.

function.name: subtract_time_delta
function.description: Subtracts a time delta from the date part of a given date time string and returns the new date string.

date_time_str.description: The date time string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

delta_days.description: Number of days to subtract. Must be greater than 0.

returns.description: The new date string after subtracting the delta.

function.name: find_nearby_stations
function.description: This endpoint provides a list of nearby weather stations for a given geographical location.

lat_long.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude.

returns.description: A list of dictionaries about the various stations near the specified location.

function.name: get_current_location
function.description: Returns the current location. ONLY use this if the user has not provided an explicit location in the query.

returns.description: The current location as a string (e.g., 'Austin').

function.name: get_current_time_at_location
function.description: Returns the current time at a given location.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the location.

returns.description: The current time at the specified location.

function.name: get_hourly_observation
function.description: Returns hourly observations between start_time and end_time.

station_id.description: The station_id for the station of interest.

time_zone.description: The timezone string ID for the location.

returns.description: A list of hourly observations for the specified station and timespan.

function.name: get_latitude_longitude
function.description: Given a city name, this function provides the latitude and longitude of the specific location.

location.description: The name of the location (e.g., 'Austin', 'Austin Airport').

returns.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude of the location.

function.name: get_nearest_station_id
function.description: Given a list of nearby stations, returns the one nearest to you and provides the system ID for it alone.

nearby_stations.description: A list of nearby stations in dictionary format.

returns.description: The station_id for the nearest station in the list.

function.name: get_timezone
function.description: This function retrieves the timezone for a given latitude and longitude.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the area.

returns.description: The timezone string ID for the specified location.

function.name: subtract_time_delta
function.description: Subtracts a time delta from the date part of a given date time string and returns the new date string.

date_time_str.description: The date time string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

delta_days.description: Number of days to subtract. Must be greater than 0.

returns.description: A list of dictionaries about the various stations near the specified location.

function.description: Returns the current location. ONLY use this if the user has not provided an explicit location in the query.

returns.description: The current location as a string (e.g., 'Austin').

function.description: Returns the current time at a given location.

returns.description: The current location as a string (e.g., 'Austin').

function.description: Returns the current time at a given location.

returns.description: A list of dictionaries about the various stations near the specified location.

returns.description: The current location as a string (e.g., 'Austin').

function.description: Returns the current time at a given location.

function.description: Returns hourly observations between start_time and end_time.

station_id.description: The station_id for the station of interest.

returns.description: A list of hourly observations for the specified station and timespan.

function.description: Given a list of nearby stations, returns the one nearest to you and provides the system ID for it alone.

function.name: find_nearby_stations
function.description: This endpoint provides a list of nearby weather stations for a given geographical location.

lat_long.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude.

returns.description: A list of dictionaries about the various stations near the specified location.

function.name: get_current_location
function.description: Returns the current location. ONLY use this if the user has not provided an explicit location in the query.

returns.description: The current location as a string (e.g., 'Austin').

function.name: get_current_time_at_location
function.description: Returns the current time at a given location.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the location.

returns.description: The current time at the specified location.

function.name: get_hourly_observation
function.description: Returns hourly observations between start_time and end_time.

station_id.description: The station_id for the station of interest.

time_zone.description: The timezone string ID for the location.

returns.description: A list of hourly observations for the specified station and timespan.

function.name: get_latitude_longitude
function.description: Given a city name, this function provides the latitude and longitude of the specific location.

location.description: The name of the location (e.g., 'Austin', 'Austin Airport').

returns.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude of the location.

function.name: get_nearest_station_id
function.description: Given a list of nearby stations, returns the one nearest to you and provides the system ID for it alone.

nearby_stations.description: A list of nearby stations in dictionary format.

returns.description: The station_id for the nearest station in the list.

function.name: get_timezone
function.description: This function retrieves the timezone for a given latitude and longitude.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the area.

returns.description: The timezone string ID for the specified location.

function.name: subtract_time_delta
function.description: Subtracts a time delta from the date part of a given date time string and returns the new date string.

date_time_str.description: The date time string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

delta_days.description: Number of days to subtract. Must be greater than 0.

returns.description: The new date string after subtracting the delta.

lat_long.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude.

returns.description: A list of dictionaries about the various stations near the specified location.

function.name: get_current_location
function.description: Returns the current location. ONLY use this if the user has not provided an explicit location in the query.

returns.description: The current location as a string (e.g., 'Austin').

function.name: get_current_time_at_location
function.description: Returns the current time at a given location.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the location.

returns.description: The current time at the specified location.

function.name: get_hourly_observation
function.description: Returns hourly observations between start_time and end_time.

station_id.description: The station_id for the station of interest.

time_zone.description: The timezone string ID for the location.

returns.description: A list of hourly observations for the specified station and timespan.

function.name: get_latitude_longitude
function.description: Given a city name, this function provides the latitude and longitude of the specific location.

location.description: The name of the location (e.g., 'Austin', 'Austin Airport').

returns.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude of the location.

function.name: get_nearest_station_id
function.description: Given a list of nearby stations, returns the one nearest to you and provides the system ID for it alone.

nearby_stations.description: A list of nearby stations in dictionary format.

returns.description: The station_id for the nearest station in the list.

function.name: get_timezone
function.description: This function retrieves the timezone for a given latitude and longitude.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the area.

returns.description: The timezone string ID for the specified location.

function.name: subtract_time_delta
function.description: Subtracts a time delta from the date part of a given date time string and returns the new date string.

date_time_str.description: The date time string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

delta_days.description: Number of days to subtract. Must be greater than 0.

returns.description: The new date string after subtracting the delta.

nearby_stations.description: A list of nearby stations in dictionary format.

date_time_str.description: The date time string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

delta_days.description: Number of days to subtract. Must be greater than 0.

returns.description: The new date string after subtracting the delta.

returns.description: A list of dictionaries about the various stations near the specified location.

returns.description: The current location as a string (e.g., 'Austin').

function.name: get_current_time_at_location
function.description: Returns the current time at a given location.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the location.

returns.description: The current time at the specified location.

function.description: Returns hourly observations between start_time and end_time.

station_id.description: The station_id for the station of interest.

time_zone.description: The timezone string ID for the location.

returns.description: A list of hourly observations for the specified station and timespan.

function.description: Given a city name, this function provides the latitude and longitude of the specific location.

location.description: The name of the location (e.g., 'Austin', 'Austin Airport').

returns.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude of the location.

function.name: get_nearest_station_id
function.description: Given a list of nearby stations, returns the one nearest to you and provides the system ID for it alone.

nearby_stations.description: A list of nearby stations in dictionary format.

date_time_str.description: The date time string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

returns.description: The new date string after subtracting the delta.

function.description: Returns the current time at a given location.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the location.

function.description: Returns hourly observations between start_time and end_time.

function.description: Given a city name, this function provides the latitude and longitude of the specific location.

function.name: get_nearest_station_id
function.description: Given a list of nearby stations, returns the one nearest to you and provides the system ID for it alone.

nearby_stations.description: A list of nearby stations in dictionary format.

function.description: This function retrieves the timezone for a given latitude and longitude.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the area.

returns.description: The timezone string ID for the specified location.

function.description: Subtracts a time delta from the date part of a given date time string and returns the new date string.

date_time_str.description: The date time string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

delta_days.description: Number of days to subtract. Must be greater than 0.

returns.description: The new date string after subtracting the delta.

function.name: find_nearby_stations
function.description: This endpoint provides a list of nearby weather stations for a given geographical location.

lat_long.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude.

returns.description: A list of dictionaries about the various stations near the specified location.

function.name: get_current_location
function.description: Returns the current location. ONLY use this if the user has not provided an explicit location in the query.

returns.description: The current location as a string (e.g., 'Austin').

function.name: get_current_time_at_location
function.description: Returns the current time at a given location.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the location.

returns.description: The current time at the specified location.

function.name: get_hourly_observation
function.description: Returns hourly observations between start_time and end_time.

station_id.description: The station_id for the station of interest.

time_zone.description: The timezone string ID for the location.

returns.description: A list of hourly observations for the specified station and timespan.

function.name: get_latitude_longitude
function.description: Given a city name, this function provides the latitude and longitude of the specific location.

location.description: The name of the location (e.g., 'Austin', 'Austin Airport').

returns.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude of the location.

function.name: get_nearest_station_id
function.description: Given a list of nearby stations, returns the one nearest to you and provides the system ID for it alone.

nearby_stations.description: A list of nearby stations in dictionary format.

returns.description: The station_id for the nearest station in the list.

function.name: get_timezone
function.description: This function retrieves the timezone for a given latitude and longitude.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the area.

returns.description: The timezone string ID for the specified location.

function.name: subtract_time_delta
function.description: Subtracts a time delta from the date part of a given date time string and returns the new date string.

date_time_str.description: The date time string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

delta_days.description: Number of days to subtract. Must be greater than 0.

returns.description: The new date string after subtracting the delta.

function.name: find_nearby_stations
function.description: This endpoint provides a list of nearby weather stations for a given geographical location.

lat_long.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude.

returns.description: A list of dictionaries about the various stations near the specified location.

function.name: get_current_location
function.description: Returns the current location. ONLY use this if the user has not provided an explicit location in the query.

returns.description: The current location as a string (e.g., 'Austin').

function.name: get_current_time_at_location
function.description: Returns the current time at a given location.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the location.

returns.description: The current time at the specified location.

function.name: get_hourly_observation
function.description: Returns hourly observations between start_time and end_time.

station_id.description: The station_id for the station of interest.

time_zone.description: The timezone string ID for the location.

returns.description: A list of hourly observations for the specified station and timespan.

function.name: get_latitude_longitude
function.description: Given a city name, this function provides the latitude and longitude of the specific location.

location.description: The name of the location (e.g., 'Austin', 'Austin Airport').

returns.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude of the location.

function.name: get_nearest_station_id
function.description: Given a list of nearby stations, returns the one nearest to you and provides the system ID for it alone.

nearby_stations.description: A list of nearby stations in dictionary format.

returns.description: The station_id for the nearest station in the list.

function.name: get_timezone
function.description: This function retrieves the timezone for a given latitude and longitude.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the area.

returns.description: The timezone string ID for the specified location.

function.name: subtract_time_delta
function.description: Subtracts a time delta from the date part of a given date time string and returns the new date string.

date_time_str.description: The date time string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

delta_days.description: Number of days to subtract. Must be greater than 0.

returns.description: The new date string after subtracting the delta.

lat_long.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude.

returns.description: A list of dictionaries about the various stations near the specified location.

function.name: find_nearby_stations
function.description: This endpoint provides a list of nearby weather stations for a given geographical location.

lat_long.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude.

returns.description: A list of dictionaries about the various stations near the specified location.

function.name: get_current_location
function.description: Returns the current location. ONLY use this if the user has not provided an explicit location in the query.

returns.description: The current location as a string (e.g., 'Austin').

function.name: get_current_time_at_location
function.description: Returns the current time at a given location.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the location.

returns.description: The current time at the specified location.

function.name: get_hourly_observation
function.description: Returns hourly observations between start_time and end_time.

station_id.description: The station_id for the station of interest.

time_zone.description: The timezone string ID for the location.

returns.description: A list of hourly observations for the specified station and timespan.

function.name: get_latitude_longitude
function.description: Given a city name, this function provides the latitude and longitude of the specific location.

location.description: The name of the location (e.g., 'Austin', 'Austin Airport').

returns.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude of the location.

function.name: get_nearest_station_id
function.description: Given a list of nearby stations, returns the one nearest to you and provides the system ID for it alone.

nearby_stations.description: A list of nearby stations in dictionary format.

returns.description: The station_id for the nearest station in the list.

function.name: get_timezone
function.description: This function retrieves the timezone for a given latitude and longitude.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the area.

returns.description: The timezone string ID for the specified location.

function.name: subtract_time_delta
function.description: Subtracts a time delta from the date part of a given date time string and returns the new date string.

date_time_str.description: The date time string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

delta_days.description: Number of days to subtract. Must be greater than 0.

returns.description: The new date string after subtracting the delta.

import requests

def get_hourly_observations(station_id, start, end, tz):
    url = "https://www.ncei.noaa.gov/cdo-web/api/v2/data"
    params = {
        "datasetid": "GHCND",
        "stationid": f"ICAO:{station_id}",
        "startdate": start,
        "enddate": end,
        "units": "metric",
        "includeAttributes": "false",
        "limit": 1000,
        "datatypeid": "TEMP",   # temperature, add others as needed
    }
    headers = {"token": "YOUR_NOAA_TOKEN"}
    resp = requests.get(url, params=params, headers=headers)
    return resp.json()

# Berlin example

- For time‑zone handling, use the following TZ database identifiers:

import requests

def get_hourly_observations(station_id, start, end, tz):
    url = "https://www.ncei.noaa.gov/cdo-web/api/v2/data"
    params = {
        "datasetid": "GHCND",
        "stationid": f"ICAO:{station_id}",
        "startdate": start,
        "enddate": end,
        "units": "metric",
        "includeAttributes": "false",
        "limit": 1000,
        "datatypeid": "TEMP",   # temperature, add others as needed
    }
    headers = {"token": "YOUR_NOAA_TOKEN"}
    resp = requests.get(url, params=params, headers=headers)
    return resp.json()

# Berlin example

function.description: This endpoint provides a list of nearby weather stations for a given geographical location.

lat_long.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude.

returns.description: A list of dictionaries about the various stations near the specified location.

function.name: get_current_location
function.description: Returns the current location. ONLY use this if the user has not provided an explicit location in the query.

returns.description: The current location as a string (e.g., 'Austin').

function.name: get_current_time_at_location
function.description: Returns the current time at a given location.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the location.

returns.description: The current time at the specified location.

function.name: get_hourly_observation
function.description: Returns hourly observations between start_time and end_time.

station_id.description: The station_id for the station of interest.

time_zone.description: The timezone string ID for the location.

returns.description: A list of hourly observations for the specified station and timespan.

function.name: get_latitude_longitude
function.description: Given a city name, this function provides the latitude and longitude of the specific location.

location.description: The name of the location (e.g., 'Austin', 'Austin Airport').

returns.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude of the location.

function.name: get_nearest_station_id
function.description: Given a list of nearby stations, returns the one nearest to you and provides the system ID for it alone.

nearby_stations.description: A list of nearby stations in dictionary format.

returns.description: The station_id for the nearest station in the list.

function.name: get_timezone
function.description: This function retrieves the timezone for a given latitude and longitude.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the area.

returns.description: The timezone string ID for the specified location.

function.name: subtract_time_delta
function.description: Subtracts a time delta from the date part of a given date time string and returns the new date string.

date_time_str.description: The date time string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

delta_days.description: Number of days to subtract. Must be greater than 0.

returns.description: The new date string after subtracting the delta.

function.name: find_nearby_stations
function.description: This endpoint provides a list of nearby weather stations for a given geographical location.

lat_long.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude.

returns.description: A list of dictionaries about the various stations near the specified location.

function.name: get_current_location
function.description: Returns the current location. ONLY use this if the user has not provided an explicit location in the query.

returns.description: The current location as a string (e.g., 'Austin').

function.name: get_current_time_at_location
function.description: Returns the current time at a given location.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the location.

returns.description: The current time at the specified location.

function.name: get_hourly_observation
function.description: Returns hourly observations between start_time and end_time.

station_id.description: The station_id for the station of interest.

time_zone.description: The timezone string ID for the location.

returns.description: A list of hourly observations for the specified station and timespan.

function.name: get_latitude_longitude
function.description: Given a city name, this function provides the latitude and longitude of the specific location.

location.description: The name of the location (e.g., 'Austin', 'Austin Airport').

returns.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude of the location.

function.name: get_nearest_station_id
function.description: Given a list of nearby stations, returns the one nearest to you and provides the system ID for it alone.

nearby_stations.description: A list of nearby stations in dictionary format.

returns.description: The station_id for the nearest station in the list.

function.name: get_timezone
function.description: This function retrieves the timezone for a given latitude and longitude.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the area.

returns.description: The timezone string ID for the specified location.

function.name: subtract_time_delta
function.description: Subtracts a time delta from the date part of a given date time string and returns the new date string.

date_time_str.description: The date time string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

delta_days.description: Number of days to subtract. Must be greater than 0.

returns.description: The new date string after subtracting the delta.

function.name: find_nearby_stations
function.description: This endpoint provides a list of nearby weather stations for a given geographical location.

lat_long.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude.

returns.description: A list of dictionaries about the various stations near the specified location.

function.name: get_current_location
function.description: Returns the current location. ONLY use this if the user has not provided an explicit location in the query.

returns.description: The current location as a string (e.g., 'Austin').

function.name: get_current_time_at_location
function.description: Returns the current time at a given location.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the location.

returns.description: The current time at the specified location.

function.name: get_hourly_observation
function.description: Returns hourly observations between start_time and end_time.

station_id.description: The station_id for the station of interest.

time_zone.description: The timezone string ID for the location.

returns.description: A list of hourly observations for the specified station and timespan.

function.name: get_latitude_longitude
function.description: Given a city name, this function provides the latitude and longitude of the specific location.

location.description: The name of the location (e.g., 'Austin', 'Austin Airport').

returns.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude of the location.

function.name: get_nearest_station_id
function.description: Given a list of nearby stations, returns the one nearest to you and provides the system ID for it alone.

nearby_stations.description: A list of nearby stations in dictionary format.

returns.description: The station_id for the nearest station in the list.

function.name: get_timezone
function.description: This function retrieves the timezone for a given latitude and longitude.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the area.

returns.description: The timezone string ID for the specified location.

function.name: subtract_time_delta
function.description: Subtracts a time delta from the date part of a given date time string and returns the new date string.

date_time_str.description: The date time string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

delta_days.description: Number of days to subtract. Must be greater than 0.

returns.description: The new date string after subtracting the delta.

function.name: find_nearby_stations
function.description: This endpoint provides a list of nearby weather stations for a given geographical location.

lat_long.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude.

returns.description: A list of dictionaries about the various stations near the specified location.

function.name: get_current_location
function.description: Returns the current location. ONLY use this if the user has not provided an explicit location in the query.

returns.description: The current location as a string (e.g., 'Austin').

function.name: get_current_time_at_location
function.description: Returns the current time at a given location.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the location.

returns.description: The current time at the specified location.

function.name: get_hourly_observation
function.description: Returns hourly observations between start_time and end_time.

station_id.description: The station_id for the station of interest.

time_zone.description: The timezone string ID for the location.

returns.description: A list of hourly observations for the specified station and timespan.

function.name: get_latitude_longitude
function.description: Given a city name, this function provides the latitude and longitude of the specific location.

location.description: The name of the location (e.g., 'Austin', 'Austin Airport').

returns.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude of the location.

function.name: get_nearest_station_id
function.description: Given a list of nearby stations, returns the one nearest to you and provides the system ID for it alone.

nearby_stations.description: A list of nearby stations in dictionary format.

returns.description: The station_id for the nearest station in the list.

function.name: get_timezone
function.description: This function retrieves the timezone for a given latitude and longitude.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the area.

returns.description: The timezone string ID for the specified location.

function.name: subtract_time_delta
function.description: Subtracts a time delta from the date part of a given date time string and returns the new date string.

date_time_str.description: The date time string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

delta_days.description: Number of days to subtract. Must be greater than 0.

returns.description: The new date string after subtracting the delta.

function.name: find_nearby_stations
function.description: This endpoint provides a list of nearby weather stations for a given geographical location.

lat_long.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude.

returns.description: A list of dictionaries about the various stations near the specified location.

function.name: get_current_location
function.description: Returns the current location. ONLY use this if the user has not provided an explicit location in the query.

returns.description: The current location as a string (e.g., 'Austin').

function.name: get_current_time_at_location
function.description: Returns the current time at a given location.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the location.

returns.description: The current time at the specified location.

function.name: get_hourly_observation
function.description: Returns hourly observations between start_time and end_time.

station_id.description: The station_id for the station of interest.

time_zone.description: The timezone string ID for the location.

returns.description: A list of hourly observations for the specified station and timespan.

function.name: get_latitude_longitude
function.description: Given a city name, this function provides the latitude and longitude of the specific location.

location.description: The name of the location (e.g., 'Austin', 'Austin Airport').

returns.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude of the location.

function.name: get_nearest_station_id
function.description: Given a list of nearby stations, returns the one nearest to you and provides the system ID for it alone.

nearby_stations.description: A list of nearby stations in dictionary format.

returns.description: The station_id for the nearest station in the list.

function.name: get_timezone

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the area.
